title: Bunny holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 34 Q58 44 56 52' stroke='#e8e8f0' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='24' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='19' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ff9db0'/>
  <path d='M62 37 L66 37 L64 41 Z' fill='#d63a5c'/>
  <!-- bunny body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='18' ry='19' fill='#f2f2f8'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='76' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#dcdce8'/>
  <!-- bunny feet -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f2f2f8'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f2f2f8'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='90' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffb6c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='90' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffb6c8'/>
  <!-- arm holding balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='60' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f2f2f8' transform='rotate(-30 57 60)'/>
  <!-- bunny head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='17' fill='#f2f2f8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='22' rx='5' ry='14' fill='#f2f2f8' transform='rotate(-12 33 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='21' rx='5' ry='14' fill='#f2f2f8' transform='rotate(12 51 21)'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='22' rx='2.5' ry='10' fill='#ffb6c8' transform='rotate(-12 33 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='21' rx='2.5' ry='10' fill='#ffb6c8' transform='rotate(12 51 21)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='2.6' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='44' r='2.6' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='36.8' cy='43.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='48.8' cy='43.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <path d='M42 50 l-2.5 -2 M42 50 l2.5 -2' stroke='#e88aa0' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 50.5 v2 M42 52.5 q-2 2 -4 0.5 M42 52.5 q2 2 4 0.5' stroke='#e88aa0' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffc9d6'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffc9d6'/>
</svg>
